description: Public Clash CLI commands. Command handlers preserve Host authority and local project observation/CAS rules.

modules.content.ts: Bounded ls/search/read commands over Host project content; exact returned media or immutable Document refs pass to existing read authorities, with no virtual filesystem or query language.
modules.actions.ts: Operation-oriented Action discovery/invoke/wait plus honest external operation/analysis records; shared runtime clients handle frozen refs, visible placement, bounded waiting and recovery identities.
modules.asset-search.ts: Query attached Asset evidence through the same Host endpoint as GUI/MCP; return exact Document revisions and available source time ranges.
modules.canvas.ts: Canvas commands use the existing Host command/REST adapters. Native Model and mapped Action Cards create/edit/copy Generator drafts and execute pinned Actions; CLI observations and Host CAS remain implicit. Help describes product behavior rather than legacy Canvas storage fields.
modules.logs.ts: Offline local diagnostics query. Never bootstrap a Host to inspect failed startup; profile resolution and beforeAction bypass live in the shared CLI program.
modules.asset-documents.ts: Native Document command/file glue over shared document-client and discovered Host API. Create, observed reads, pull/apply, explicit copy, and same-Document attachment advance. No public CAS flags or tokens.
modules.asset-metadata.ts: Read/validate historical manifest metadata. Set/apply are explicit retired errors pointing to native Document commands; descriptive Media facts are not automatically Documents.
modules.projection.ts: Canvas/Timeline native projection command glue. Historical metadata:* projections are retired; Documents use the existing Document client and format contract.
